content.short: L2 Optimizoooors provides gas-efficient calldata routers for Aave, Connext, and Superfluid.
content.description: L2 Optimizoooors is an open-source ScopeLift project that maintains an open GitHub repository containing optimized calldata routers for Aave, Connext, and Superfluid across three L2 networks. These routers are designed for developers building applications that access the supported networks, enabling integration that can substantially reduce user gas costs. Reported savings include about 27% on Aave, 46% on Connext, and 34% on Superfluid, helping apps deliver lower transaction fees to users while preserving functionality.
